about: Plain prompts for measuring formwork/route.md. Each has the kind, size and first step a correct route picks. A list means any of those values is right. "*" means any value is right. tag says what the prompt tests.

firsts.do: the session that got it does it now, one line said back
firsts.brief: the director writes a brief and stops
firsts.round: the director writes a round brief and stops
